scripts.dev: pnpm run env:check && pnpm --filter @socialgrowth/product-contracts build && pnpm --filter @socialgrowth/product-backend build && tsx scripts/product-local-live.mts serve
scripts.dev:demo: pnpm run env:check && concurrently --kill-others --success first --names runtime,web "pnpm run runtime:start" "pnpm run runtime:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @socialgrowth/product-contracts run build && pnpm --filter './product/**' --workspace-concurrency=1 run build
scripts.check:product: pnpm --filter @socialgrowth/product-contracts run build && pnpm --filter './product/**' --workspace-concurrency=1 run check
scripts.test:product: pnpm --filter @socialgrowth/product-contracts run build && pnpm --filter './product/**' --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.test:all: tsx --test tests/core-process-acceptance.test.ts services/execution-runtime/src/*.test.ts apps/artemis-controller/src/*.test.ts apps/web-console/lib/first-loop/*.test.ts tests/first-loop-integration.test.ts
scripts.runtime:start: pnpm run env:check && node --env-file=.env.runtime --import tsx services/execution-runtime/src/server.ts
